title: Decide whether an AutoGen change can ship
description: Select a change, inspect its required evidence, and adjust measured results. Promotion stays blocked until every applicable gate has a named artifact and passing threshold.

changes.label: Prompt or model change
changes.detail: Inference behavior changes while the team, tools, and state schema remain fixed.
changes.rollout: Shadow evaluation, then a small fresh-run canary.

changes.label: Tool or permission change
changes.detail: The candidate changes which external effects an agent can request or execute.
changes.rollout: Deny by default, canary one effect class, and monitor authorization decisions.

changes.label: Team or routing change
changes.detail: Participants, order, selector policy, handoffs, or termination behavior changes.
changes.rollout: Compare against the simpler baseline, then canary with hard turn and time limits.

changes.label: Framework or extension upgrade
changes.detail: AutoGen packages, runtime adapters, model clients, or serialized state behavior changes.
changes.rollout: Canary fresh runs first; migrate resumable state only after compatibility proof.

gates.label: Single-agent baseline
gates.detail: The multi-agent candidate beats a simpler control on representative tasks after latency and cost are included.

gates.label: Routing slice review
gates.detail: Speaker selection, handoffs, skipped roles, and loop cases pass per-slice thresholds.

gates.label: Loop and budget limits
gates.detail: Turn, message, token, tool, time, and spend limits terminate predictably.

gates.label: Denied-action suite
gates.detail: Cross-tenant, wrong-role, stale-approval, and prompt-injected actions remain denied.

gates.label: Idempotency replay
gates.detail: Duplicate delivery and timeout reconciliation cannot repeat a consequential effect.

gates.label: Checkpoint replay
gates.detail: Representative stored states load, resume, and preserve expected next-speaker and tool-receipt behavior.

gates.label: Fresh-run canary
gates.detail: New runs can be routed independently and stopped without forcing old state onto new workers.

gates.label: Mixed-version isolation
gates.detail: Old and new workers cannot write incompatible formats into the same checkpoint population.

gates.label: Failure-injection suite
gates.detail: Model errors, handler failures, tool timeouts, restarts, and unavailable dependencies have bounded outcomes.

gates.label: Trajectory review
gates.detail: Offline traces show agent, message, model, tool, retry, termination, and final-disposition boundaries.

gates.label: Telemetry redaction
gates.detail: Sensitive prompt, tool, result, identity, and credential fields follow a reviewed logging policy.

gates.label: Rollback rehearsal
gates.detail: A named owner has restored the previous candidate and reconciled in-flight runs in a rehearsal.
